description: GrokBuild + Codex team orchestration: run a named team of cooperating workers with durable script-managed state under .omo/teams. MUST USE when the user asks to create, run, coordinate, inspect, archive, or delete a team of agents/subagents/sessions, or to work as a team in parallel. On GrokBuild, FIRST select transport spawn_subagent (host spawn_subagent + bind-subagent). On Codex, select multi_agent_v2 or codex_app. The main session is always the leader; members are concrete part/ownership/perspective slices - never vague job roles. Triggers: team mode, teammode, make a team, run as a team, team of agents, parallel subagents, coordinate workers, archive the team.
